synopses.long:
Have the time of your life at Michelle's Fabulous Friday party packed with party hits. Here everyone is welcome, everyone is equal and everyone is a superstar. Expect to hear all your favourite disco, dance, pop and R&B bops hand-picked by Michelle.

To listen on most smart speakers, just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Michelle Visage.'

Produced by Mostest for BBC Radio 2.
